Review_note: External score: the strongest characteristic, missing for about half of applicants; being missing is itself informative. It plays the role a credit bureau score would (FA7.2 s7).
Bureau debt / credit, over credits with known debt (amounts owed, FA7.2 s6). Missing means no usable bureau debt data, which is not the same as zero debt.
Average age of bureau credits: length of credit history (time at bureau, FA7.2 s6).
Credit card debt / card credit: total utilisation (FA7.2 s6). Missing means no file or no card with a known balance.
Days since the most recent credit was opened (recent trades, FA7.2 s6).
Share of bureau credits still active (amounts owed, FA7.2 s6).
Education: predictive, but a socio-economic proxy (FA7.1 s14).
Occupation groups: capacity to repay (FA7.1 s10); groups formed automatically, review for sense.
City-adjusted region rating: same concern as REGION_RATING_CLIENT.
Credits opened in the last 24 months (trades opened recently, FA7.2 s6).
Days since the applicant last changed phone: can be read as stability, but has no clear causal story for a mortgage.
Employer type: employment status (FA7.2 s6); groups formed automatically, review for sense and fairness.
Age: monotonic and predictive, but a protected characteristic; already used to define the segment (21-55).
Population density of the region: a geographic proxy with no direct Singapore meaning.
Number of active bureau credits (total trades, FA7.2 s6).
Number of closed bureau credits: length and depth of credit history (FA7.2 s6).

Age of the applicant's car; blank means no car (structurally missing, FA9.1 s5). Car ownership is more common among men, and in Singapore a car's COE lasts 10 years, so the older-car bins may rarely apply.
Time in the current job (time at employment, FA7.2 s6): income stability, part of capacity (FA7.1 s10). Split once at 3 years so that it measures stability rather than seniority.
Any overdue now, ever overdue, or sold / written-off credit: payment history (number of delinquencies, FA7.2 s6).
Income type: employment status (FA7.2 s6).
Whether document 3 was provided: no clear causal story; would need confirming for a mortgage application.
Current living arrangement (residential status, FA7.2 s6); every applicant owns no property, so it describes how they live now.
Registered city differs from work city: same concern as REG_CITY_NOT_LIVE_CITY.
Registered city differs from living city: Singapore is a single city, so this cannot be collected locally.
Income is not in SGD, so its bins would not transfer to Singapore incomes without rescaling.
